title: Chunking Strategies Rag
motto: Chunking configuration influences retrieval quality as much as the choice of embedding model (Vectara NAACL 2025). Get chunking wrong and no amount of reranking saves you.

steps.title: Core idea
steps.body: Chunking configuration influences retrieval quality as much as the choice of embedding model (Vectara NAACL 2025). Get chunking wrong and no amount of reranking saves you.

steps.title: The problem
cards: You put a 50-page contract into a RAG system. User asks: "What is the termination clause?" The retriever returns the cover page. Why? Because the model was trained on 512-token chunks and the termination clause sits 20 pages in, split across a page break, with no local keywords tying it to the query.
The fix is not "buy a better embedding model." The fix is chunking. How big? Overlap? Where to split? With surrounding context?
